name: srun
description: Keep secret values out of Claude Code. The agent uses a secret by NAME through `srun NAME -- cmd`; srun fetches the value from Keychain, 1Password, Dashlane, LastPass, AWS or GCP, gives it to that one command, and masks it out of the output. `srun import` moves secrets out of .env files. Hooks block reading .env files, keychain and store reads, and mask credential-shaped strings. Run /srun:setup once per project.
